en.title: Create and Publish Events
en.excerpt: Complete guide to designing events from draft, category configuration, to public release.

toc.text: Data that needs to be prepared

en.content:
Requirements

To create an event, your account must be of type Organization and have an active subscription package in accordance with the requirements of the event module to be used.

Data that needs to be prepared

  • Name of event and identity of organizer.
  • Implementation date, location, and PIC.
  • Open competition categories/divisions.
  • Participant quota per category.
  • Payment scheme (free/paid) and registration deadline.

Event Creation Step

  1. Go to Organization Dashboard -> Events -> Create Event.
  2. Fill in the basic event information and upload the banner.
  3. Add competition categories, quotas, and technical parameters.
  4. Configure important registrations, fees, and schedules.
  5. Save as a draft, then review the data with the committee team.

Publishing Event

After validation is complete, click Publish so that the event appears on the public page. As long as the registration period is still running, you can still make corrections to non-critical content.

Pre-Release Checklist

  • Make sure all categories have quotas and schedules.
  • Check the registration price and payment status.
  • Recheck the event description to avoid multiple interpretations.
  • Make sure the operational team is ready to monitor incoming registration.

id.title: Membuat dan Mempublish Event
id.excerpt: Panduan lengkap merancang event dari draft, konfigurasi kategori, hingga rilis publik.
id.content:
Persyaratan

Untuk membuat event, akun Anda harus bertipe Organisasi dan memiliki paket berlangganan aktif sesuai kebutuhan modul event yang akan digunakan.

Data yang Perlu Disiapkan

  • Nama event dan identitas penyelenggara.
  • Tanggal pelaksanaan, lokasi, dan PIC.
  • Kategori/divisi lomba yang dibuka.
  • Kuota peserta per kategori.
  • Skema pembayaran (gratis/berbayar) dan tenggat pendaftaran.

Langkah Membuat Event

  1. Masuk ke Dashboard Organisasi -> Event -> Buat Event.
  2. Isi informasi dasar event dan unggah banner.
  3. Tambahkan kategori lomba, kuota, and parameter teknis.
  4. Konfigurasikan pendaftaran, biaya, serta jadwal penting.
  5. Simpan sebagai draft, lalu review data bersama tim panitia.

Mempublish Event

Setelah validasi selesai, klik Publish agar event tampil di halaman publik. Selama periode pendaftaran masih berjalan, Anda tetap bisa melakukan koreksi konten non-kritis.

Checklist Pra-Rilis

  • Pastikan semua kategori memiliki kuota dan jadwal.
  • Periksa harga pendaftaran dan status pembayaran.
  • Cek ulang deskripsi event agar tidak menimbulkan interpretasi ganda.
  • Pastikan tim operasional sudah siap memantau pendaftaran masuk.
